heard: Josiah was young when he became king He did what was right in the Lord's sight In his twelfth year he began to cleanse Idols and images cast to the dust He tore down the altars of Baal And scattered the dust over the graves He burned the bones of the priests And cleansed Judah and Jerusalem He humbled himself before the Lord Tore his clothes and wept in sorrow He heard the words of the law And sought the God of Israel Luke, I found the book of the law hidden in the house of the Lord Shaphan brought it to the king and read the words in his presence When the king heard the law's command, he tore his clothes in great distress He sent messengers to hold the prophetess in Jerusalem He humbled himself before the Lord, tore his clothes and wept in sorrow He heard the word
